title: Israel allowing traders to bring into Gaza ‘dual-use’ items barred from aid organisations
summary: Sources say generators and tent poles restricted from humanitarian bodies but commercial shipments allowed in Israel is running a parallel system of controls for shipments into Gaza, allowing commercial traders to bring goods into the territory that are barred for humanitarian organisations. Basic life-saving supplies including generators and tent poles are on a long Israeli blacklist of “dual-use” items. The Israeli government says entry of these items must be severely restricted because they could be exploited by Hamas or other armed groups for military ends. Continue reading...
